'''Wole Vahn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He lived sometime before the [[Great Galactic War]], and he was considered one of the greatest Jedi Masters of the Order during his time. His wisdom, knowledge, and personality was later imprinted on the [[Noetikon of Light]], and Vahn's personality inhabited the device along with Masters [[Noab Hulis]] and [[Nomi Sunrider|Nomi Da-Boda]].
